specs.title: FR15-TC01 admin can log in through the UI and reach the product tab @fr15
FR15-TC02 a non admin account is refused by the admin console @fr15
FR15-TC03 creating a product through the UI persists it @fr15
FR15-TC04 editing a product through the UI updates it in the database @fr15
FR15-TC05 editing one product renames every row in the admin table @fr15
FR15-TC06 deleting a product through the UI removes it everywhere @fr15
FR15-TC19 xss payload in the product name is stored verbatim @fr15
FR15-TC20 empty product name is blocked by the HTML5 required attribute only @fr15
FR15-TC07 product can be created without any authorization header @fr15
FR15-TC08 product can be updated without any authorization header @fr15
FR15-TC09 product can be deleted without any authorization header @fr15
FR15-TC10 a plain user token can create products @fr15
FR15-TC21 list and detail endpoints disagree on the price type of the same product @fr15
FR15-TC11a empty product name is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC11b missing product name is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC11c whitespace only product name is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC12a negative price is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC12b zero price is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC13 alphabetic price is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC14a price above max safe integer loses precision @fr15
FR15-TC14b price at max safe integer is stored exactly @fr15
FR15-TC18 unknown category id is accepted @fr15
FR15-TC15 delete on a missing id reports success @fr15
FR15-TC16 get on a missing id returns an empty object @fr15
FR15-TC17a even product id returns price as string @fr15
FR15-TC17b odd product id returns price as number @fr15
